Body.Content:
As organizations expand beyond one-time asset sales to rental, leasing, and servitization business models, new rental management capabilities help them manage and monetize the assets they build, own, and operate throughout the rental lifecycle. In Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management, organizations can manage availability and reservations, fulfillment, delivery and pickup, inspections, and returns. These capabilities can help improve fleet utilization, reduce idle time, and streamline the movement of fleet items between locations, jobsites, and customers. Together, connected rental processes across supply chain, service, and finance can help organizations reduce operational costs, improve asset utilization, and generate value throughout the life of an asset.

GA date: August CY2027

Preview date: October CY2026
